# Banned witness claims (ADR 0308, Gap R.190).
#
# One phrase per line; `#` starts a comment. A line of a scanned file that matches one of these
# — case-insensitively, and unless it also carries a marker from
# witness-history-markers.txt — is a claim that somebody RAN the retired AST interpreter, or
# compared two engines that no longer exist. Restate it as the record leg, the reference leg,
# or both legs (AGENTS.md § One execution backend).
#
# These are run-oriented on purpose. Naming the interpreter as the *source of a recorded answer*
# is not a false claim — the record is that engine's answer — so "the record says", "the retired
# engine printed" and every past-tense measurement are fine, and the markers file is what tells
# the two apart.
#
